verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local MoE inference engine. It offers its own one-shot chat command, an OpenAI-compatible chat server, and on-device and desktop apps, so users can prompt a built-in model directly. Nothing shows agentic task delegation such as tool use, multi-step execution or actions inside the product, so chat is only a thin form of the story. Missing for 10: documented task-delegation or agent capabilities, tool or action execution, description of the in-app assistant experience, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: One-shot chat (pass --max-new to cap length; add --show-thinking to print the model's reasoning block too)
macOS: local CLI / daemon / desktop app (Rust)
